comment: Power-efficiency schedule. RULES: (1) night sleep stays ON in every phase — it is an invariant, the controller refuses a phase that sets it and pauses if the node reports it off; (2) a phase only counts if its report passes the coverage gate (measured contiguous discharge spans covering >= min_coverage_ratio of the accrued battery time), otherwise it is reported invalid and counted in powerbench_phase_discarded_total; (3) the node must be UNPLUGGED for the whole block — charging pauses the clock, so a plugged-in node simply accrues nothing (PowerbenchNoBatteryTime alerts). One cycle = one local discharge day (~13 h awake in the daytime record window, the rest asleep); each phase wants >=3 cycles, hence 36 battery-hours. A phase is judged on the median cycle slope in mV/h, with the cycle IQR as the noise band: if the ranges overlap, it is not a result yet.

phases.name: reference
phases.why: Shipping config as it stands on the node today. Establishes the cycle-to-cycle noise band (~36 battery-hours = ~3 discharge cycles) that every later phase is judged against.

phases.name: cpu80
phases.why: REC-phase CPU at 80 MHz (v1.54-hardened path; the dump header always reads 160 because the clock is raised after association, so this is verified from controller state only). The only idle-slice knob with a plausible signal in the re-analysis.
